name: Maryvale #2
summary: Step into a world where contemporary design harmoniously blends with everyday comfort. This newly constructed farmhouse at 4 Maryvale Road offers an expansive 5,439 square feet of sophisticated living space, thoughtfully designed to cater to both relaxation and entertainment.

From the gourmet kitchen equipped with top-of-the-line appliances to the serene outdoor area featuring a wood-burning fire pit, every detail has been meticulously crafted to elevate your living experience.
